quotes.text: DTE Vantage has been a strong non-utility business and valued part of DTE Energy for more than 30 years.
quotes.by: Joi Harris, DTE president and CEO

quotes.text: Strong financial performance through the third quarter of 2026 positions us to continue investing in Michigan’s energy infrastructure while delivering long-term value for our customers, communities and shareholders.
quotes.by: David Ruud, DTE vice chairman and CFO

outlook: DTE Energy confirms 2026 operating EPS guidance of $7.59 to $7.73.
DTE Energy also provided a 2027 operating EPS pro forma baseline 2 range of $7.59 - $7.73, which reflects the DTE Vantage asset sale.

items.heading: Changes to Michigan's electric retail access program could negatively impact the Registrants' financial performance.

The Clean Energy Standard, Renewable Portfolio Standard and energy waste reduction may affect the Registrants' business and federal and state fuel standards may affect DTE Energy's non-utility investments.
DTE Energy's ability to utilize tax credits may be limited.

The Registrants' electric distribution system and DTE Energy's gas distribution system are subject to risks from their operation, which could reduce revenues, increase expenses, and have a material adverse effect on their business, financial position, and results of operations.
Construction and capital improvements to the Registrants' power facilities and DTE Energy's distribution systems subject them to risk.
Operation of a nuclear facility subjects the Registrants to risk.
